description: This file defines the ResourceDeleted event class which is emitted after a resource associated with a policy is deleted. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON, accessing properties like label and resource key, and handling serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: ResourceDeleted
classes.description: An immutable event class representing the deletion of a resource in a policy, providing creation, serialization, and property access methods.

methods.name: ResourceDeleted of
methods.description: Factory method to create a ResourceDeleted instance with specific policy ID, label, resource key, revision, timestamp, and headers.

methods.name: ResourceDeleted fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ResourceDeleted instance from a JSON string.

methods.name: ResourceDeleted fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ResourceDeleted instance from a JSON object.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the policy entry associated with this event.

methods.name: getResourceKey
methods.description: Returns the resource key of the deleted resource.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new ResourceDeleted instance with updated revision.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new ResourceDeleted instance with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path representing the location of this resource deletion event.
